item.description: Heart-wrenching video shows an Orange police officer jumping into action to help save a baby who was choking. item.title: TSA workers mistaken for ICE agents, prompting protest in Lynwood
item.description: An apparent mix-up led to a group of people protesting outside a restaurant in Lynwood.According to a report from FOX 11’s Matthew Seedorff, two TSA agents were eating at the restaurant when they were allegedly mistaken for ICE agents.The confusion prompted a group of demonstrators to arrive in the area to protest what they believed to be ICE agents at the scene.This is a developing story. Stay with FOX 11 as we continue to bring you updates from the scene.
